input.demand: Raw nonnegative pickup counts in zone order. Oldest hour first.
input.context: Aligned numeric inputs in context_columns order. Calendar flags are 0/1; continuous weather uses (value - mean) / std. is_raining is 1 when precipitation exceeds 0.1 mm.
input.calendar: Use New York local time. Hour encodings use 2*pi*hour/24. Weekday encodings use 2*pi*weekday/7 with Monday=0. Use federal holiday flags and the transition-hour DST flag from the notebook.
input.origin: ISO timestamp of the last input row. Estimate mode includes an assumed count for the in-progress current hour; it is not an observed current pickup count.
